criteria.description: A reference shared by distinct issues is counted once per issue while same-issue duplicates remain deduplicated.
A truncated selection stays incomplete without downgrading fully qualified emitted issues.
Top-level and per-issue totals, buckets, sources, and reconciliation facts are exact.
The route is one bounded typed call with unchanged arguments, no retry, no widened limit, and no request for reference URLs or issue narrative; no narrative content is copied.
The answer contains only the requested structured projection and a concise brief.
